specification.objective: Record the unresolved project-selector visual height mismatch as future work without changing runtime behavior.

requirements.statement: A TODO adjacent to the Kanban project selector must mark its visible height mismatch with neighboring controls on mobile and desktop as unresolved future work.

acceptance_criteria.statement: One concise TODO comment immediately above the selector construction states that its visible height still appears mismatched with adjacent controls on mobile and desktop; no runtime code or tests change.
docs/contracts/project-selector-height-follow-up-v1.polis.json is byte-for-byte identical to the locked contract.

invariants.statement: The project selector's value, options, visual rendering, selection callback, accessibility semantics, and all other runtime behavior remain unchanged.

forbidden_states.statement: The TODO changes runtime behavior, claims the visual mismatch is fixed, or omits either mobile or desktop from the follow-up note.

inputs.statement: The existing Kanban project selector implementation and the user's reported visual discrepancy.

outputs.statement: A code comment recording the selector-height discrepancy for future resolution.

failure_semantics.statement: Any runtime change or missing mobile/desktop scope violates the requested documentation-only outcome.
